messages.subject: Last meeting of the quarter plus a mini-workshop on dissertating with aggiedown!
parts:
Hi all, 

Can't believe Fall quarter is already coming to a close. Join us this week for a mini-workshop on aggiedown, which provides a template for writing your dissertation in R Markdown in compliance with UC Davis formatting requirements. Liza will walk us through how aggiedown works and Ryan will be there to answer questions! 

As always, we will be in person in the Datalab Classroom (360 Shields Library) from 12 - 2pm, as well as online via zoom. 

Hope to see you there!
Your D-RUG Coo[R]dinators
